paper_a.title: Partition relations for $\eta_\alpha$ and for $\aleph_\alpha$-saturated models (Erdos-Hajnal-Milner 1972)

paper_b.title: Megjegyzesek egy versenyfeladathoz / Remarks on a competition problem (Erdos-Suranyi 1959)

metadata.description: Both papers were curated as the Hamiltonicity pair Erdos-Gallai (1959) vs Chvatal-Erdos (1972) on sufficient conditions for graph Hamiltonicity via degree sums and connectivity/independence. However, both extracted PDFs are registry mismatches: paper347 is the Erdos-Hajnal-Milner 1972 paper on infinitary partition relations $E \to (\mathrm{Dense}(\mathcal{F}), [m,\Theta])^2$ for $\aleph_\alpha$-quasi filters and $\aleph_\alpha$-saturated models, while paper348 is the Erdos-Suranyi 1959 Hungarian-language paper on a number-theoretic divisibility competition problem (Gallai's question on selecting integers from a consecutive block whose product is divisible by $a_1 \cdots a_n$). The two extracted papers share no mathematical content: one lives in infinitary set theory / model theory, the other in elementary combinatorial number theory. PDF-fallback extraction on both sides; no Hamiltonian-graph results appear in either JSON. All Level-1 paper-origin nodes are emitted as `none`.
